description: Election Commission - Mr. D. Moni of the Nuwaraeliya Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member of that Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns a member of a local authority (Nuwaraeliya Pradeshiya Sabha) vacating their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and the administration of local government elections, specifically fitting Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for matters related to electoral boundaries, candidate registrations, and declarations about the status of elected members.
